title: Pair at Rest
description: A hen mallard sits sharp in the foreground while her drake rests soft behind her. Shot from grass level so the blades frame the pair and the background falls away to green.
alt: Pair at Rest, Female Mallard Duck

title: Hen in Profile
description: A tight profile showing the dark eye stripe and the orange edge of the bill. The out-of-focus field becomes an even wash of olive and gold.
alt: Hen in Profile, Female Mallard Duck

title: Eye Line
description: Close enough to see individual feathers across the face. A pale, quiet background keeps all the attention on the eye.

title: Over the Shoulder
description: Her own back feathers fill the foreground, layering the frame and pulling the eye straight to hers.
alt: Over the Shoulder, Female Mallard Duck

title: Hen in Soft Light
description: Even light brings out the mottled browns of her plumage, with a flash of the blue-and-white wing patch at the edge of the frame.
alt: Hen in Soft Light, Female Mallard Duck

title: Drake and Hen
description: The same moment as 'Pair at Rest', seen as the drake's portrait: his green head is the soft counterweight behind the hen.
alt: Drake and Hen, Male Mallard Duck

title: Drake in Tall Grass
description: Seed heads frame a drake resting at the water's edge. The dark background lets the white collar and pale bill stand out.
alt: Drake in Tall Grass, Male Mallard Duck

title: Iridescence
description: In the right light a drake's head shifts from blue to emerald. A close crop keeps the color, the yellow bill and the eye together.

title: Drake on the Lawn
description: A full-body portrait at eye level, with clean bands of green grass above and below.
alt: Drake on the Lawn, Male Mallard Duck

title: Vapor
description: A Blue Angels F/A-18 pulls hard enough to wrap itself in condensation, with vapor trailing from the wingtips.

title: Tight Pair
description: Two Blue Angels jets bank in close formation, near enough to read the U.S. Navy lettering on the tails.

title: Three Ship
description: Three jets cross the frame trailing white smoke, each holding its own line against an overcast sky.

title: Spotters
description: Away from the flying, a team on a rooftop tracks the show with scopes and long lenses, silhouetted against the sky.

title: Vertical
description: An F/A-18 climbs straight up with vapor streaming off the fuselage. The vertical frame exaggerates the climb.

title: Four in Echelon
description: Four Blue Angels stacked in tight echelon with smoke on, shot from below against a flat grey sky.

title: No Hands
description: A freestyle motocross rider lets go of the bike at the top of a jump, framed against bright cloud.

title: Wall of Fire
description: The show's pyrotechnic wall of fire erupts behind a Blue Angels F/A-18 sitting on the runway.

title: Colors
description: A parachutist descends with a full-size American flag and a trail of red smoke through the dark smoke left over from the pyrotechnics.

title: Great Horned Owl
description: An adult great horned owl tucked deep in the branches, its plumage almost the same color as the bark.

title: Owlets
description: Downy great horned owlets crowd a single branch. One looks straight at the camera while its siblings face away.

title: Head On
description: A pied-billed grebe looks straight into the lens, its reflection broken up by algae on the surface.

title: Banded Bill
description: A clean side profile showing the black band across the bill and the pale ring around the eye.

title: Drip
description: A single drop hangs from the grebe's bill, its body mirrored in the still water below.

title: Swallow
description: The grebe tips its head back, bill open, mid-swallow.

title: No Kings
description: A handmade banner reading 'We the People / No Kings in America (official since 1776)', hung on a weathered wooden fence.

title: Impeach
description: A single word on yellow poster board, held high against the sky next to a traffic signal.

title: Liberty, Head in Hands
description: A protester at the roadside holds an image of the Statue of Liberty covering her face.

title: Resist
description: A child holds up a 'Resist Fascism' sign among the adults at the rally.

title: Margins
description: A hand-lettered sign whose margins have filled up with notes and signatures from other marchers.

title: Collage
description: A homemade collage sign built from cut-out photographs and lettering, held above the crowd.

title: Ruddy Duck Drake
description: A male ruddy duck in breeding plumage: chestnut body, white cheek, sky-blue bill and a stiff tail cocked upright.

title: Tail Up
description: Seen nearly head-on, the bright blue bill and fanned tail look almost cartoonish against the dark water.
